en.title: 🚨Notice on Regular Safety Training Completion for Undergraduate Students in Practical/Lab Courses for the 2026 Academic Year🚨
summary: Notice on completing regular safety training and submitting certificates for undergraduate students enrolled in practical/lab courses for the 2026 academic year.

Target: Undergraduate students taking science/engineering, art, and physical education lab courses (including computer practice; students enrolled in Object-Oriented Programming 2 sections 001–003 and Artificial Intelligence Programming sections 001–002).

Submission method: Print the safety training certificate from the Laboratory Safety Management System and submit it in person to the department office (60th Anniversary Memorial Building, Room 909) or via email (kkn25@inha.ac.kr).
en.easyExplanation: This notice is for undergraduate students enrolled in practical courses such as Object-Oriented Programming 2 and Artificial Intelligence Programming. You must complete the online safety training via the Laboratory Safety Management System and submit the completion certificate to the department office in person or via email by Thursday, October 29.
en.target: Undergraduate students taking science/engineering, art, and physical education lab courses (including computer practice) [Eligible undergraduate lab courses: Object-Oriented Programming 2 - sections 001, 002, 003; Artificial Intelligence Programming - sections 001, 002]

author: 김경남
originalContent:
[ 2026학년도 실습/실험과목 학부생 정기 안전교육 안내 ]
1. 근거 : 연구실안전환경조성에 관한 법률 제 20조(교육 및 훈련)
2. 대상
가. 이공계 및 예체능 실험과목 수강 학부생(컴퓨터 실습 포함)
나. 교육대상 학부실험과목 리스트
- 객체지향프로그래밍2 - 001, 002, 003분반 (60주년-906호)
- 인공지능프로그래밍 - 001, 002 분반 (60주년-906호, 5서관 361호)
3. 기한 : 10월 29일(목)까지
4. 제출 : 2026학년도 안전교육 이수증을 학과사무실로 제출 (방문제출 또는 학과 메일 제출)
(연구실안전관리시스템 → 안전교육 → 이수증명서 → 증명서 출력)
※ 학과 사무실 : 60주년 909호 / 학과 이메일 : kkn25@inha.ac.kr (메일제목 : 2026학년도 안전교육 이수증 제출_학번_이름)
